title: SEC1: Unify MethodError and JmapError into single canonical type
description:
MethodError (jmap.rs) and JmapError (error.rs) are structurally identical — same fields, same serde attributes, same constructors (invalid_arguments, forbidden_method, not_found, server_fail, cannot_calculate_changes). The only difference: state_mismatch() exists only in error.rs; cannot_calculate_changes() in jmap.rs.

Fix: remove MethodError from jmap.rs entirely. Use JmapError (from error.rs) everywhere. In jmap.rs, replace 'pub struct MethodError {...}' with 'pub use crate::error::JmapError;' if MethodError is referenced from jmap module. Update any tests that reference MethodError.

Why this matters: every new error variant requires updating both types + both test suites. Breaking change risk grows linearly with variants.
